snippet.title: Hexplorando: Rebuild the World | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing Hexplorando, a cozy new puzzle-building game developed by Hexplora Interactive!

Rebuild the world, one hex at a time!
40 real-world locations
Hundreds of landmarks
Endless worlds in Sandbox

Coming to PC & Nintendo Switch in 2027
Wishlist now at https://store.steampowered.com/app/2736590/Hexplorando/
